context.description: Slug of the bounded context this service belongs to. Defaults to the name of the input directory.

contextName.description: What the context is called on the page. Defaults to the slug, titled.

contextSummary.description: A sentence or two on what the context is responsible for.

classification.description: Whether the context is core to the business, supports it, or is generic and could be bought.

service.description: Slug of the service. Defaults to the name of the input directory.

serviceName.description: What the service is called on the page. Defaults to the title of its README, and failing that to the slug, titled.

repo.description: Where the source lives. Defaults to the scm url in pom.xml.

store.description: Slug of the database this service keeps its state in, the same one the sql extractor is given. It is here for the flows: a call on a port lands somewhere, and only the manifest knows where.

peers.description: Which service answers for what this one calls, as the contract vendored beside the adapter to the callee's service id: the proto package for a gRPC peer, the api id of the OpenAPI document (its x-portolan-api, or its title and major version) for an HTTP one. A package with no line here, and none under externals, is called as unknown and its steps stay unresolved.

externals.description: Which system outside the estate answers for what this one calls, as the api id of the document vendored beside the adapter to the external's id - the same bare name the openapi extractor is given under external. The calls land on the operations the copy declares and are declared, not unresolved; the lane says the far end is outside.

events.description: Which aggregate another service's events belong to, as the package a listener reads them from to the aggregate id, so a policy reacting to a foreign event resolves.

source.description: The directory the packages start in, relative to the input root.

out.description: Name of the fragment file, inside the step's output directory.
